passages.provision_quote: an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase
passages.note: Statewide cap and just-cause rules both preserve stricter existing local ordinances untouched and exempt new construction, so it does not cleanly separate rung 2 from rung 3.
Robert Rivas voted Aye on the Assembly's final concurrence in Senate amendments.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 26 NVR Count 5

rows.reasoning: Robert Rivas voted Aye on AB 1482 (2019-2020), which caps annual rent increases statewide and requires just cause for eviction after 12 months, but the bill explicitly leaves existing local rent-control ordinances unchanged ('the local ordinance shall apply') rather than strengthening them, while also exempting housing built within the previous 15 years so market rents apply there. The vote shows support for tenant protections generally but does not separate 'Strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units' from 'Maintain current tenant protections while allowing market rents for new construction.'
